remarks: Perfection in Riverside! Move right into this beautiful, recently expanded and meticulously maintained charming Cape in the ideal Riverside location with gorgeous back yard. FAR allows expansion to 4500sf. Great proportions, flow and finishes of this special home with first floor option for primary suite with full bath. Fenced yard with professional landscaping and spacious outdoor deck creates a serene environment. Large living room with fireplace, formal dining room, solarium, expanded kitchen and powder room on first floor. Upstairs you will find the original primary bedroom with ensuite full bath, 2 additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. Large family room with stone fireplace with gas log-set, custom paneling & built-in cabinetry on lower level with laundry room and half bath. 1/2 Mile to MetroNorth Train Station and town center in Old Greenwich. *NOTE: ALL OFFERS MUST BE RECEIVED PRIOR TO SUNDAY 2/2/25 @ 5:00PM TO BE CONSIDERED!

facts.laundryLoc: Lower level, plus hook-up on 1st flr.
